title: David Omobolaji Olabiyi (1989–2023)
content: David Omobolaji Olabiyi, Ph.D., passed away suddenly on 7 December 2023 in his apartment at University of Florida (UF). His passing came just seven months after he was conferred a doctorate in entomology from UF, and only a month after presenting his research on invasive pests of citrus at the National Annual Meeting of the Entomological Society of America (ESA), National Harbor, MD. Throughout his career, David earned numerous accolades, including the 2023 Ph.D. Poster Presentation Award at the Florida Entomological Society (FES) Annual Meeting at Jupiter, Florida, and the 2023 UF Entomology Student Organization Travel Grant Award to the Entomological Society of America (ESA) Southeastern Branch Meeting at Little Rock, Arkansas. Additionally, David was a recipient of the 2018 Commonwealth Shared Scholarship, sponsored by the UK Department for 2018 International Development (UK/DFID) and Harper Adams University, United Kingdom, to study for his master's degree in integrated pest management.
